# Management repository operation

Read the frozen management batch and phase guidance via `session_context`. Include every source and preserve unrelated user work and submodule checkouts.

Analysis: report conflict count and choices. Do not merge. No conflicts does not mean synchronized or verified safe. If asked to merge without frozen approval, provide the management-task link and explain the required confirmation. Changed source, target or choices require new analysis and approval.

Integration: recheck frozen source and target immediately before merging. On changes, stop and report blocked for new analysis and confirmation. Execute only the frozen approval and selected resolutions. Report the actual targetHead through the existing structured result channel; the host verifies the entire batch. Chat completion is not a receipt.

Build/verify the integrated target, retaining evidence in `_nestos/kanban/artifacts/`. Service replacement and guarded cleanup belong to the host; never infer either from merge approval.
